title: Question 11
passage:
Is that the bell for our guided tour, or the one for the café?
A. It's for the café. Our guide is still handing out badges. B. There are seats near the café window. C. We had a different guide yesterday.
passageZh:
那是我們導覽的鈴聲，還是咖啡館的？
A. 是咖啡館的。我們的導覽員還在發識別牌。 B. 咖啡館窗邊有位子。 C. 昨天是另一位導覽員。
